owner=str(uuid4());run=next(r['"'"'id'"'"'] for r in g if r['"'"'kind'"'"']=='"'"'managed-run'"'"')
def seal(r): r['"'"'digest'"'"']=sha256(canonical({k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='"'"'digest'"'"'})).hexdigest()

 b=next(r for r in graph if r['"'"'kind'"'"']=='"'"'task-brief'"'"');b['"'"'payload'"'"'][field]=value;seal(b)
 m=graph[-1];m['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'entries'"'"'][0]['"'"'brief_ref'"'"']=records.reference(b);seal(m)
class SubDB:
 def __init__(self): self.reads=0
 async def execute(self,q,params):
  assert str(q).startswith('"'"'SELECT '"'"')

 def scalar_one_or_none(self): return '"'"'SUBSTITUTED_owned_reference'"'"'
async def get(*args): return None

 except CatalogError as exc: actual=str(exc)
 assert actual==expected,(name,actual,expected)
 assert canonical(graph)==before
 results.append({'"'"'case'"'"':name,'"'"'actual'"'"':actual,'"'"'db_reads'"'"':db.reads,'"'"'graph_unchanged'"'"':True})
async def main():
 with patch.object(ma.catalog,'"'"'get'"'"',get):
  await verify('"'"'legacy_positive'"'"',deepcopy(g),'"'"'ACCEPTED'"'"')
  await verify('"'"'missing_manifest'"'"',[r for r in deepcopy(g) if r['"'"'kind'"'"']!='"'"'launch-manifest'"'"'],'"'"'MANAGED_REJECTED'"'"')
  await verify('"'"'extra_manifest'"'"',deepcopy(g)+[records.envelope('"'"'launch-manifest'"'"',deepcopy(g[-1]['"'"'payload'"'"']))],'"'"'MANAGED_REJECTED'"'"')
  for field in ('"'"'done_when'"'"','"'"'return_when'"'"'):
   bad=deepcopy(g);b=next(r for r in bad if r['"'"'kind'"'"']=='"'"'task-brief'"'"')
   brief_mutation(bad,field,[{'"'"'bound_procedure_ref'"'"':b['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'procedure_bindings'"'"'][0]['"'"'bound_procedure_ref'"'"'],'"'"'predicate_id'"'"':'"'"'normalize-records'"'"'}])
   await verify('"'"'legacy_nonempty_'"'"'+field,bad,'"'"'BOUND_PREDICATE_GAP'"'"')
  for value in (None,True,False,0,5,1.0,'"'"'1'"'"',[],{}):
   bad=deepcopy(g);bad[-1]['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'composition_version'"'"']=value;seal(bad[-1])
   await verify('"'"'version_'"'"'+json.dumps(value),bad,'"'"'INVALID_TYPE'"'"' if type(value) is float else '"'"'MANAGED_REJECTED'"'"')
  for kind in ('"'"'bound-procedure'"'"','"'"'prompt-bundle'"'"'):
   bad=deepcopy(g);b=next(r for r in bad if r['"'"'kind'"'"']=='"'"'task-brief'"'"')
   if kind=='"'"'prompt-bundle'"'"':
    value=deepcopy(b['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'prompt_bundle_ref'"'"']);value['"'"'id'"'"']=str(uuid4());brief_mutation(bad,'"'"'prompt_bundle_ref'"'"',value)
   else:
    value=deepcopy(b['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'procedure_bindings'"'"']);value[0]['"'"'bound_procedure_ref'"'"']['"'"'id'"'"']=str(uuid4());brief_mutation(bad,'"'"'procedure_bindings'"'"',value)
   await verify('"'"'foreign_'"'"'+kind,bad,'"'"'REF_UNAVAILABLE'"'"')
  bad=deepcopy(g);bad[-1]['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'resolution'"'"']='"'"'MODEL'"'"';seal(bad[-1]);await verify('"'"'not_NO_MODEL'"'"',bad,'"'"'MANAGED_REJECTED'"'"')
  m=g[-1];st=stage(m);binding=c.binding_record(m,st,str(uuid4()),authority());final={**st,'"'"'status'"'"':'"'"'BLOCKED'"'"','"'"'reason'"'"':'"'"'NO_MODEL'"'"','"'"'binding_ref'"'"':records.reference(binding)}
  assert c.validate_final(final,m,binding)==final;results.append({'"'"'case'"'"':'"'"'final_positive'"'"','"'"'actual'"'"':'"'"'BLOCKED_NO_MODEL'"'"'})
  for name,update in (('"'"'final_SUCCEEDED'"'"',{'"'"'status'"'"':'"'"'SUCCEEDED'"'"','"'"'reason'"'"':'"'"'CONTRACT_PURE'"'"'}),('"'"'final_executions'"'"',{'"'"'executions'"'"':[]})):
   try: c.validate_final({**final,**update},m,binding)
   except CatalogError as exc: actual=str(exc)
   else: raise AssertionError('"'"'final attack accepted'"'"')
   assert actual=='"'"'MANAGED_REJECTED'"'"';results.append({'"'"'case'"'"':name,'"'"'actual'"'"':actual})
  b=next(r for r in g if r['"'"'kind'"'"']=='"'"'task-brief'"'"');checker=next(r for r in g if r['"'"'kind'"'"']=='"'"'method-checker'"'"');blocked=c.blocked_result(b)
  check=await managed._result_check(SubDB(),owner,run,b,blocked,records.reference(checker),graph=g)
  assert check['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'status'"'"']=='"'"'INCOMPLETE'"'"';results.append({'"'"'case'"'"':'"'"'result_check_positive'"'"','"'"'actual'"'"':'"'"'INCOMPLETE'"'"'})
  spoof=deepcopy(blocked);spoof['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'status'"'"']='"'"'SUCCEEDED'"'"';seal(spoof)
  try: await managed._result_check(SubDB(),owner,run,b,spoof,records.reference(checker),graph=[*g,binding,records.envelope('"'"'native-task-receipt'"'"',final)])
  except CatalogError as exc: actual=str(exc)
  else: raise AssertionError('"'"'legacy COMPLETE'"'"')
  assert actual=='"'"'METHOD_RECEIPT_MISMATCH'"'"';results.append({'"'"'case'"'"':'"'"'cannot_COMPLETE'"'"','"'"'actual'"'"':actual})
  bundle=next(r for r in g if r['"'"'kind'"'"']=='"'"'prompt-bundle'"'"');bound=next(r for r in g if r['"'"'kind'"'"']=='"'"'bound-procedure'"'"')
  try: c.validate_assignment(b,bound,prompt_bundle=bundle,composition_version=1)
  except CatalogError as exc: actual=str(exc)
  else: raise AssertionError('"'"'original legacy regression absent'"'"')
  assert actual=='"'"'BOUND_PREDICATE_GAP'"'"';results.append({'"'"'case'"'"':'"'"'old_default_v1_regression_RED_control'"'"','"'"'actual'"'"':actual})
  composed=c.build_records(selection,ref('"'"'native-preparation-receipt'"'"'),next(q['"'"'ref'"'"'] for q in bindings if q['"'"'entity_kind'"'"']=='"'"'procedure'"'"'),procedure,bindings,'"'"'b06b-publish-contract'"'"','"'"'RECON'"'"',1,datetime.now(UTC),composition_packages=packages)
  assert mc.stage_payload(composed[-1],composed)['"'"'protocol'"'"']=='"'"'omnis-managed-admission-v2'"'"'
  results.append({'"'"'case'"'"':'"'"'composed_v1_stage_positive'"'"','"'"'actual'"'"':'"'"'ACCEPTED'"'"'})
  downgrade=deepcopy(composed);del downgrade[-1]['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'composition_version'"'"'];seal(downgrade[-1])
  await verify('"'"'removed_version_retained_composition_ref'"'"',downgrade,'"'"'MANAGED_REJECTED'"'"')
  del downgrade[-1]['"'"'payload'"'"']['"'"'entries'"'"'][0]['"'"'composition_ref'"'"'];seal(downgrade[-1])
  await verify('"'"'erased_version_and_composition_ref_zero_predicates'"'"',downgrade,'"'"'ACCEPTED'"'"')
  assert mc.stage_payload(downgrade[-1],downgrade)['"'"'protocol'"'"']==c.PROTOCOL
  results.append({'"'"'case'"'"':'"'"'downgrade_forces_NO_MODEL_v1_no_execution'"'"','"'"'actual'"'"':c.PROTOCOL})
asyncio.run(main())
